notes: Odds & value: a Japanese card typed with its English name finds the Japanese card now. When no English card has the number and set size typed (Altaria 074/068), GrailCrest looks in the Japanese sets and offers the Japanese card, with its picture, and prices it as a Japanese card.

Backs: a piece of the surface torn off (bare white card stock showing in the blue border) now counts as surface damage, about a PSA 4. It was missed before because the back's dotted border read as printed design.
